field_edits.updated_text: Marrow edema involving the anterolateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle consistent with a bone contusion. No acute fracture, dislocation, or marrow-replacing lesion.
Mild peritendinous/peribursal fluid between the lateral femoral condyle and the adjacent iliotibial band, likely representing iliotibial band friction syndrome. No mass or fluid collection.

impression:
1. Bone contusion of the anterolateral aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.
2. Mild peritendinous/peribursal fluid adjacent to the iliotibial band consistent with iliotibial band friction syndrome.
